Sandbox_EmreRE9_EnableSpawns_tooltip: Allow RE9 in suitable vehicle zones in newly explored areas. Existing vehicles are kept. The game vehicle-spawn setting must also be enabled.
Sandbox_EmreRE9_SpawnFrequency_tooltip: Relative RE9 selection weight: Rare 0.35x, Normal 1x, Common 3x. These are not fixed percentages; other vehicles and game vehicle settings still apply. Restart the save after changing.
Sandbox_EmreRE9_EnablePartLoot_tooltip: Add RE9 tires, saddles, tanks and exhausts to mechanics, garages and mechanical storage. Also supplies compatible standard parts where missing. Does not remove the base game loot.
Sandbox_EmreRE9_PartsFrequency_tooltip: Relative RE9-specific part weights: Rare 0.35x, Normal 1x, Common 3x. Standard batteries/brakes retain their base-game weights. Applies to newly generated loot; restart after changing.
Sandbox_Cessna172_TakeoffSpeed_tooltip: Ground speed the Cessna needs before it lifts off. Lower takes off sooner and flies slower before it stalls. Default 45.
Sandbox_Cessna172_EngineAutoOff_tooltip: How long the engine keeps running with nobody in the pilot's seat before it switches itself off. 0 switches it off straight away. -1 never switches it off. Default 60.
